text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Whoops, almost forgot.
It's about time for training—

text_block_list.name: Freshman Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Um, I'd like to go to the gym!
Could you tell me the way...?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Ah~, it's easy for new students to get lost.
Leave it to me! I'll take you there!!

text_block_list.name: Freshman Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Thank you so much for going out of your way!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry about it!
Wait, more importantly, do you know how to use the equipment?
If you'd like, your "senpai" here can teach you!

text_block_list.name: Freshman Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Are you sure, Senpai?
Don't you have things to do...?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
"No problem at all!
I can't turn down a junior's request!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, thoroughly flattered into playing the senior,
Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi ended up
skipping her training...
